assertionStrength.experiment: Temporarily remove the production persistence extension from the owned test server, then select the disconnect/eviction case.
assertionStrength.observed: The persistence assertion failed because edited content was absent from PostgreSQL, after successful fixture setup and WebSocket synchronization.
assertionStrength.restored: The final source restores the extension; the complete 18-case run passes without skips.

limits: Native CI verification awaits publication; this is a focused local suite, not a full server integration result.
Hocuspocus uses its service lockfile and real room validator/persistence extension. HTTP forwards to the real persistence route and actual database writes.
Browser/session authentication and database routing remain fixture seams. Redis fanout and the built service container are not covered here.
The experiment proves assertion sensitivity to absent persistence, not a replay of a particular historical production incident.
